title: Earthquake in Mall World
content: Last night in my dream Mall World couldn't decide what it wanted to be, it simultaneously looked like a mall, an airport, a school and a hospital (does this happen to anyone else?). There happened to be some sort of earthquake or ground disturbance in the dream. The first time it happened the lights flickered, you could hear the building shifting and moving. Everyone stopped what they were doing to attempt to balance themselves and not fall over but many people did, grabbing onto each other on their way to the ground. I ran through a door and into a stairwell, gripping the railings for stability. When I made it to the floor below me, everything instantly reset. I was on the upper floor again moments before the earthquake began, I had gone back one minute or so in time. This time, I noticed a father and his teenage son. Instantly, I recognized them as people I needed to help for some reason. I walked over and told them an earthquake was about to happen, and they needed to get to the stairs immediately. The father didn't believe me at first, but his son walked straight into the elevator. The lights flickered, and then it started. I thought I had more time. In the midst of the earthquake (for the second time) the father and I pulled the boy out of the elevator and made our way to the stairwell. Then I woke up. Has anyone else experienced anything like this? I read somewhere that some dream interpreters see public places like malls/airports/schools as a realm between ours and another.
